place_fields.summary: Adventure sports centre near Ramadevara Hills offering trekking and outdoor activities including ziplining, rope activities, rappelling, kayaking and boating.

planning_attributes.description: Adventure sports centre near Ramadevara Hills with trekking and multiple outdoor adventure activities.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Ramadivaraditta Road near Ramadevara Hills in Ramanagara; Ramanagara railway station is about 2.71 km away.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: A visitor review describes a tricky rocky final stretch to the summit and recommends carrying plenty of water and wearing sports shoes.
planning_attributes.notes: Reported activities include ziplining, rope activities, rappelling, kayaking and boating.

place_fields.summary: Sangama is the confluence of the Arkavathi and Kaveri rivers in Kanakapura taluk, associated with the Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary and used for nature and water-based recreation.

planning_attributes.description: Sangama is the meeting point of the Arkavathi and Kaveri rivers and a visitor destination within the Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary landscape, with trekking and river activities reported for the area.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The name Sangama refers to the confluence where the Arkavathi joins the Kaveri.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Sangama has road connectivity from Kanakapura; the Ramanagara district tourism page places it about 59 km from Bengaluru and 60 km from Ramanagara.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Forest-area access and activities may require applicable permits or booking; follow current Forest Department instructions at the entry point.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: River conditions can be hazardous; visitors should follow local Forest Department directions and avoid entering restricted water areas.
planning_attributes.notes: The Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary includes Sangama and Mekedatu in its Kanakapura Wildlife Range.
